The '''Wroonian defense force''' was a military organization charged with the defense of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[T'Charek Haathi]] served with defense force as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] until her [[Unidentified Wroonian defense force starfighter squadron|squadron]] went rogue.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
